aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:858.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary Ther Sr Manager, Paid Media serves as the strategic leader for the organization's paid media ecosystem, overseeing the development, direction, and performance of all paid media efforts across search, social, display, video, and emerging digital channels. This position leads the organization's audience strategy, measurement frameworks, and optimization models to improve marketing efficiency and conversion outcomes at scale. Develop and lead audience targeting and segmentation strategies that advance full funnel performance, strengthen campaign relevance and efficiency, and drive meaningful improvements in return on investment. Establish and oversee optimization frameworks, experimentation models, and performance standards that strengthen campaign effectiveness and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, revenue outcomes, and return on ad spend. Own paid media budget strategy, forecasting, scenario planning, and investment decisions to drive performance against KPIs and revenue goals while maximizing overall organizational efficiency. Lead paid media strategy for theme nights, ticketing campaigns, and tentpole moments by overseeing integrated planning and execution that aligns channel investment, audience targeting, and creative direction with organizational revenue and engagement goals. rws-rws:lever:0401437c-2347-4c56-a3ec-54.description: About the Role In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis. Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data. Job Type: Freelance Location: India (work from home) Work Schedule: Part-time — 4 hours per day required. (Flexible schedule: you can choose your hours as long as the daily time requirement is met). Work whenever you want. Start Date: Immediately Duration: TBC Rate: 6 USD per hour What You’ll Do Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present in the audio and on-screen text. Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., verifying that the media content uses authentic target language and aligns with the cultural context of that language). Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines. Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models. What we’re looking for: Must be currently living in India. Native-level written and spoken fluency in Telugu. Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop. Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines. (Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.
